title: 金融大亨沃尔特急售湖人队，帝国重组引关注
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Mark Walters, one of America's wealthiest financiers.
segments.zh: 马克·沃尔特斯，美国最富有的金融家之一。

segments.en: And the real story is Mark Walters was in the backwaters of finance in the late 1990s.
segments.zh: 而真实的故事是，马克·沃尔特斯在1990年代末还处于金融的边缘地带。

segments.en: No one knew him. He was running a asset-backed securitization firm tied with the commercial paper marketplace. But the real trick,
segments.zh: 没人认识他。他经营着一家资产证券化公司，与商业票据市场紧密相连。但真正的诀窍，

segments.en: the real game-changer for him was a meeting with one of the descendants of the original Guggenheim, Dynasty Meyer, Guggenheim, the mining baron from the Gilded Age, right?
segments.zh: 对他来说真正的转折点，是与古根海姆家族后裔的一次会面，即镀金时代的矿业大亨迈耶·古根海姆的后代，对吧？

segments.en: He meets his great grandson who's not happy with how advisors have been dealing with that family money. They come up with this plan where he folds his firm into their family office
segments.zh: 他见到了那位曾孙，对方对顾问处理家族资金的方式不满。他们制定了一个计划，他将自己的公司并入家族办公室。

segments.en: and today somehow become no connection to that family, but somehow he's become torch bearer for that great family name, for that Guggenheim name. Because once he
segments.zh: 如今，尽管与那个家族已无关联，但他却成为了那个伟大姓氏——古根海姆的传承者。因为一旦他

segments.en: fold that firm, he grew that into Guggenheim investments. Guggenheim's securities run by former Bairston, CEO Alan Schwartz, with all that money expanded into other investments,
segments.zh: 合并了那家公司，他就将其发展成了古根海姆**公司。古根海姆证券由前贝尔斯登CEO艾伦·施瓦茨管理，凭借这些资金扩展到其他**领域，

segments.en: most prominently a stable of expansive and some glittering sports teams, Los Angeles Dodgers, the Chelsea Football Club, Cadillac F1 team, and up until recently,
segments.zh: 最引人注目的是拥有一系列扩张且耀眼的体育队伍：洛杉矶道奇队、切尔西足球俱乐部、凯迪拉克F1车队，以及直到最近，

segments.zh: 还有洛杉矶湖人队。我们之所以谈论这一切，是因为那个震惊的消息。一位职业体育队老板在购买不到一年后就出售球队，转手球队。
